te: The present-day location of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is first explored by the Portuguese under their commissioned Floren…
dz: 现在的巴西里约热内卢位置是由葡萄牙人在佛罗伦萨探险家亚美利哥·韦斯普奇 (Amerigo Vespucci) 的委托下首次探索的。韦斯普奇开始怀疑欧洲和亚洲之间有一整片大陆。
de: The present-day location of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is first explored by the Portuguese under their commissioned Florentine explorer, Amerigo Vespucci. Vespucci begins his suspicion that there is a whole continent between Europe and Asia.

t: 瓦斯科·达·加马从葡萄牙里斯本起航,第二次出航印度.
te: Vasco da Gama sets sail from Lisbon, Portugal, on his second voyage to India.
dz: 瓦斯科·达·加马从葡萄牙里斯本起航,第二次出航印度.
de: Vasco da Gama sets sail from Lisbon, Portugal, on his second voyage to India.

t: 瓦斯科·达·伽马 (Vasco da Gama) 率领 15 艘船和 800 名船员从葡萄牙里…
te: Vasco da Gama sets sail with 15 ships and 800 men from Lisbon, Portugal on his second voyage to India.
dz: 瓦斯科·达·伽马 (Vasco da Gama) 率领 15 艘船和 800 名船员从葡萄牙里斯本起航，开始第二次印度之旅。
de: Vasco da Gama sets sail with 15 ships and 800 men from Lisbon, Portugal on his second voyage to India.

te: Isabella I issues an edict outlawing Islam in the Crown of Castile, forcing virtually all her Muslim subjects to conver…
dz: 伊莎贝拉一世颁布法令,宣布卡斯蒂利亚王室中的伊斯兰教为非法,迫使她几乎所有的穆斯林臣民皈依基督教.
de: Isabella I issues an edict outlawing Islam in the Crown of Castile, forcing virtually all her Muslim subjects to convert to Christianity.

t: 克里斯多夫·哥伦布从卡迪兹出发进行第四次出航.
te: Christopher Columbus sets off from Cádiz for his fourth voyage.
dz: 克里斯多夫·哥伦布从卡迪兹出发进行第四次出航.
de: Christopher Columbus sets off from Cádiz for his fourth voyage.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布在第四次出海期间降落在洪都拉斯近海的湾群岛的瓜纳哈.
te: Christopher Columbus lands at Guanaja in the Bay Islands off the coast of Honduras during his fourth voyage.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布在第四次出海期间降落在洪都拉斯近海的湾群岛的瓜纳哈.
de: Christopher Columbus lands at Guanaja in the Bay Islands off the coast of Honduras during his fourth voyage.
